fields.description: How often the background job polls every enabled Uptime Kuma Instance's /metrics endpoint. Takes effect on its own within a minute of saving — no restart needed.
fields.label: Poll Interval (minutes)

fields.description: A site is flagged Critical once more than half of its last N checks report Down. A single check reporting Up resets the majority the moment it tips back below 50%.
fields.label: Alert Window (checks)

fields.description: Keeps every enabled instance in sync with the fleet: pulls in monitors that already exist on an instance's Kuma but aren't tracked here yet (e.g. one added directly in Kuma), and pushes sites that already exist on other instances onto one that's missing them (e.g. a newly connected instance). Turn off to only add/sync sites via "Add Site" or a manual "Import Existing Monitors" pass.
fields.label: Keep Instances In Sync

fields.description: How often each instance is checked for monitors not yet tracked here. Runs less often than polling since it needs a Socket.IO login, not just an HTTP GET.
fields.label: Auto-Import Interval (minutes)
